blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — The Department of Agriculture (DA) in Northern Mindanao (Region 10) has extended farm equipment assistance to the city government and farmers’ groups here worth around P6.6 million to boost farm production and livelihood opportunities. Jose Apollo Pacamalan, DA-10 regional director, and Valencia City Vice Mayor Greizl Galario-Fernandez signed the Memorandum of Agreement last Thursday for the farm equipment grant. Funded under the DA’s 2025 corn and rice programs, the initiative is aimed at boosting agricultural production, enhance farming efficiency, and strengthen community resilience for local farmers.
